integrity: Exact analytic support maximization, polar area integration, strict derivative-sign analysis and affine limiting argument are supplied. Finite numerical checks are supplementary and cannot replace proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-radius centrally symmetric intersections of exactly two planar disks; a=1 is a degenerate excluded boundary; no general higher-dimensional conclusion; unindexed historical priority remains possible.
title: Sharp Mahler-product monotonicity of symmetric planar circular lenses
